about: Per-test time limit on the Windows CI shards (TAB-201), checked by scripts/test-timings.mjs --budget. The test timeout is 60 s; a test slower than half of it fails the job by name, so it is made cheaper before it becomes a flaky timeout. Set from five main runs (15 Windows samples per test, 2026-10-09): every test but the two exempted ones stayed under 23 s. An exemption needs its own limit and a reason; remove it once the test is fast.

exempt.test: a crash at every boundary of the swap leaves the data wholly old or wholly new
exempt.reason: Walks every crash boundary of the swap: median 20.5 s, worst 44.6 s on Windows. To be slimmed by the restore owner; then this exemption goes.

exempt.test: writes the room file within about 30 seconds
exempt.reason: Waits for the relay's 30 s maximum save delay by design (30.3 s on Windows).
